title: 100ms Room
description: A persistent container for a 100ms live session. Rooms are created from templates; each instance of users joining a room is a session.

region.description: Region the room is provisioned in. `in` = Mumbai, `us` = US, `eu` = EU, `auto` = closest to peer.

size.description: Soft cap on concurrent peers (subject to plan limits).

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum continuous session duration before the room is auto-ended.

large_room.description: When true, this is a 'large room' (10k+ peers) which changes the underlying topology.
